summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Charlton Aria Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing overdue periodic reports (Form 10-K and Form 10-Q). There is no special situation: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or management change. The filing solely resolves a prior listing deficiency and closes the matter.
